scope: Byte-identical CUDA top-k selection and block-reduction references used to derive CTOX's single-request SM86 top-k/top-p sampling candidate. The TensorRT-LLM framework is not linked or compiled into the model crate.

files.purpose: Two-stage repeated top-k reduction, exponential weighting, nucleus boundary, and random-threshold selection reference.
TopK_2 insertion and block-reduction comparison contract used by the upstream sampling stages.

notes: Vendored files are reference material only and retain their upstream copyright and Apache-2.0 headers.

The CTOX adaptation accepts one already resident finite f32 distribution, one caller-supplied unit-interval draw, and a bounded top-k. It remains verifier-only until same-device parity, distribution, performance, and lifecycle evidence pass.
No TensorRT-LLM runtime, CUDA Runtime API, CURAND state, or framework allocator is introduced.
